features.description: After Sticky Re-drops, Rainbow activates Golden Squares with Coins, Clover and Pot Of Gold. Green Clover multiplies neighbouring coins, Golden Clover multiplies every value, and Pot Of Gold gathers Coin values.

features.title: Bonus Choice and Stone Tablets
features.description: Three FS symbols allow a choice of Luck of the Pharaoh with ten spins or Lost Treasures with three replenishable lives. Sticky Stone Tablets in Lost Treasures add to or multiply Coin values; four FS symbols award Super variants.

intro: The game uses a 5×3 grid and 10 paylines. Each high-paying symbol belongs to its own Chamber and matching Key; three identical Keys open that Chamber and trigger its Hold and Spin Bonus Game.

Hold and Spin opens a separate 3×3 grid with three spins. A new coin resets the counter to three; coins include Collectors, Multipliers, Value Raisers and Mystery Symbols. Master Key can open every Chamber at once.
playn-go-chambers-of-ancients.editorial: Chambers of Ancients makes keys specific to particular bonus chambers rather than simple Scatter equivalents. Expanding Wilds help ordinary wins, while Hold and Spin has a separate 3×3 economy with its own coin effects.

features.title: Keys to Chambers
features.description: Three matching Keys open the corresponding Chamber and its Hold and Spin.

features.title: Hold and Spin 3×3
features.description: A new coin resets three spins, while Collector, Multiplier, Value Raiser and Mystery change rewards.

features.title: Master Key
features.description: Master Key can open every Chamber at once.

features.title: Expanding Wilds
features.description: Wild expands across a full reel, while three Scatters separately award Free Spins.

intro: Regal Knights reveals Mystery Symbols as one matching ordinary symbol, Wild or Golden Mystery. The golden variant triggers an extra respin with a prize set.
Three Scatters award eight Free Spins. Every four new Scatters within the bonus turn one low-paying symbol category into Mystery on subsequent spins.
push-gaming-regal-knights.editorial: Regal Knights emphasises gradually removing weak symbols: starting with four or five Scatters unlocks one or two progression levels in advance.

features.title: Golden Feature
features.description: Golden Mystery awards a separate respin with values, a collector, multiplier or Scatter.

features.title: Eight Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger the series, while four or five provide a grid upgraded in advance.

features.title: Progressive Free Spins
features.description: Every four new Scatters on the meter convert a low-paying symbol into Mystery.

intro: Criss Cross 81 uses four reels and 81 paylines. Mystery Bonus replaces standard coin collection here: a mysterious symbol can award a separate reward.
Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols and can carry a x2 multiplier. The provider separately mentions a large win for three sevens.
wazdan-criss-cross-81.editorial: The 81 in the name refers to paylines rather than 81 independent cells. This matters when comparing it with nine-reel Hold the Jackpot games.

features.title: 81 paylines
features.description: Four reels calculate combinations across a large set of fixed paylines.

features.title: Mystery Bonus
features.description: A mysterious symbol unlocks an independent payout with a provider-stated limit for that bonus.

features.title: Wild with x2
features.description: Substitutes for ordinary symbols and can double the corresponding winning combinations.

intro: Lava Coins 2 increases paying lines to fifteen and expands the central reel, where five Collect symbols can lock in the bonus.
During Hold & Win, the volcano adds held multipliers: the first level is x2, while another eruption on the same cell raises it by one.
3-oaks-gaming-lava-coins-2.editorial: This is more than a new Lava Coins background. Version 2 uses up to five Collect symbols, Volcano Multipliers and a Lava Spins mode that guarantees Bonus and Collect for x15 the stake.

features.title: Up to five Collect symbols
features.description: Two Bonus symbols and one Collect trigger three respins; collectors lock on the expanded central reel.

features.title: Volcano Multipliers
features.description: An eruption can add up to six sticky multipliers and resets the respin counter.

features.title: Lava Spins x15
features.description: A separate stake guarantees at least one Bonus Symbol and Collect on the base spin.

intro: Golden Squares appear beneath wins and reveal Coins, Green/Gold Clover, Bags of Gold or Pots of Gold with Rainbow. Bags collect neighbouring values, while Pots collect across the entire grid.
A Wild contributing to a win gives its position a x2 Position Multiplier. This applies to future wins on the cell and doubles each time a new Wild wins in the same position.
hacksaw-gaming-le-prechaun.editorial: Le Prechaun adds lasting positional progression to Golden Squares: Wild substitutes for a symbol and fixes a multiplier on a specific cell, which can keep doubling through repeat winning landings.

features.title: Golden Squares and collector scope
features.description: Rainbow reveals Coins, Clovers, Bags and Pots of Gold from Golden Squares. Bag collects neighbouring cell values, while Pot collects across the whole grid; Epic Rainbow reveals special symbols in every position.

features.title: Position Multiplier from a winning Wild
features.description: A Wild position involved in a win receives a x2 multiplier. The cell continues acting as a Golden Square, while every subsequent winning Wild there doubles its Position Multiplier.

features.title: Lucky Charm Bar in three bonuses
features.description: Arc Adventure with three FS symbols awards ten spins and Lucky Charm Bar with extra FS symbols and multipliers. Clover the Top retains Golden Squares after activation, while Shamrock ’n’ Roll starts the meter at its highest level.

intro: Each Champion has its own effect: Syn the Shapeshifter changes high-paying symbols, Gorm turns 1–5 symbols into Wilds, Silvana adds 4–7 Wilds, Olc turns central reels into Wild reels, and Anastina creates a large cluster of one symbol.

Three orb Scatters trigger Mini-Game. Collecting three tokens of a particular Champion unlocks its Free Spins power; three potions boost the multiplier, while three additional Scatters can add more Free Spins.
playn-go-champions-of-mithrune.editorial: Champions of Mithrune uses characters as a set of reel operations, with Mini-Game determining in advance which Champion powers enter Free Spins. Bonus strength therefore depends on the number of genuinely unlocked heroes rather than one meter.

features.title: Champion powers
features.description: Syn changes high-paying symbols; Gorm, Silvana and Olc create Wild effects, while Anastina forms a cluster.

features.title: Mini-Game
features.description: Three Orb Scatters unlock token collection, where three tokens of one hero activate its ability.

features.title: Potions
features.description: Three potions boost the multiplier, while extra Scatters increase Free Spins.

features.title: Selected heroes
features.description: Only Champion powers unlocked beforehand enter the bonus.

intro: Retro Sweets uses a 6×9 grid with Cluster Link: groups of five matching sweets form wins. Wild Candy contributes to clusters and accumulates +1 to its own multiplier.
Unlike Retro Tapes, this has Instant Prize Multiplier, while Sweet Collector can draw scattered Wild Candies, coins and ordinary symbols into one winning group.
push-gaming-retro-sweets.editorial: This is a separate Retro-series version: Sweet Collector and Instant Prize Multiplier should not be mechanically transferred to RetroVerse.

features.title: Wild Candy
features.description: Wild Scatter adds one to its multiplier after contributing to a winning cluster.

features.title: Sweet Collector
features.description: Draws one paying symbol type, Wild Candy or Instant Prizes together to form a cluster.

features.title: Push Bet
features.description: Increasing the stake can guarantee one or two Wild Candies on a base spin.

intro: Cube Mania uses cascades: winning symbols disappear, while new symbols fall from above and can continue the current combination.
Three Scatters award 15 free spins, while four award 30. Mystery Bonus from three mysterious symbols provides a separate payout, while an x2 multiplier wall boosts corresponding cascades.
wazdan-cube-mania.editorial: Cube Mania has two separate triggers: Scatter for Free Spins and Mystery for an instant bonus. Cascades form the foundation but do not replace those features.

features.title: Cube cascades
features.description: Winning symbols are removed, while new ones fill cells from above.

features.title: Fifteen or thirty spins
features.description: Three Scatters trigger 15 Free Spins, while four Scatters trigger 30.

features.title: Mystery and an x2 wall
features.description: Three Mystery symbols unlock a separate prize, while the multiplier wall enhances wins within the corresponding sequence.

intro: Little Farm uses a 5×4 grid and twenty-five paylines: Dog Wild helps form wins, while farmer Boost totals visible Bonus Chicken prizes.
Six Bonus symbols, or five Bonus symbols with Boost, unlock Hold & Win. In a separate Free Spins mode, the dog moves along the reels, becoming a Walking Wild when the fox appears.
3-oaks-gaming-little-farm.editorial: Grand 5000x belongs to filling the entire bonus grid rather than every chicken symbol. Walking Wild works in Free Spins and does not replace Farmer Boost.

features.title: Farmer Boost
features.description: The farmer gathers visible Bonus chicken values and adds to the current payout.

features.title: Hold & Win and Grand 5000x
features.description: Six Bonus symbols, or five with Boost, trigger three respins; filling the grid can award Grand.

features.title: Dog Walking Wild
features.description: The dog moves around the grid in Free Spins and leaves new Wilds while chasing the fox.

intro: Winning positions become Golden Squares. Rainbow activates them and reveals Coins, Clover symbols, Santa Sacks or Jackpot Boxes; Santa Sacks collect all visible Coin and other Sack values.
Jackpot Boxes can appear directly or from Golden Squares. Rainbow activating a Box makes it award one of four jackpot prizes; multiple Boxes add their jackpot rewards together.
hacksaw-gaming-le-santa.editorial: Le Santa builds its cash phase around two collectors: Santa Sacks aggregate ordinary Coin values, while Jackpot Boxes add separate fixed jackpot rewards. The top Wreck the Halls bonus guarantees Rainbow on every free spin.

features.title: Rainbow and Golden Squares
features.description: After an ordinary winning combination, Golden Squares remain beneath winning positions. Rainbow reveals Coins, Clovers, Santa Sacks or Jackpot Boxes, taking the win into a new prize phase.

features.title: Santa Sacks and Jackpot Boxes
features.description: Santa Sacks collect visible Coin and other Sack values. Jackpot Boxes reveal one of four fixed prize levels only with Rainbow activation; multiple Boxes can add their rewards together.

features.title: Silent Heist, Sleighing It, Wreck the Halls
features.description: Three FS symbols award ten Silent Heist Spins with Golden Squares retained until first activation. Four FS symbols unlock Sleighing It with persistent cells; five unlock Wreck the Halls with guaranteed Rainbow every spin.

intro: Charlie Chance starts with 243 Dynamic Payways. A winning combination containing Wild highlights its reel, after which the horizontal Multiplier Reel stops above it and applies the landed multiplier to all wins formed through that reel.

Two or more Scatters trigger Second Chance Re-Spins: reels with Scatters lock, while new Scatters continue the sequence. Three, four and five Scatters unlock Flaming, Inferno and Hellfire Free Spins respectively, with different multiplier sets; bonus Wilds remain on the grid but change position every spin.
playn-go-charlie-chance.editorial: Charlie Chance links three Free Spins levels to the Scatter count collected before bonus entry. Second Chance Re-Spins offers a chance to reach a higher tier, while Multiplier Reel continues boosting specifically the wins passing through the selected Wild reel.

features.title: Multiplier Reel
features.description: A Wild win highlights its reel; the horizontal reel assigns a multiplier to all wins through it.

features.title: Second Chance Re-Spins
features.description: Two Scatters hold the corresponding reels; new Scatters extend repeat spins.

features.title: Three bonus levels
features.description: Three, four and five Scatters trigger Flaming, Inferno and Hellfire Free Spins.

features.title: Moving Wilds
features.description: Wilds remain until the Free Spins series ends but change position every spin.

intro: RetroVerse uses Cluster Link and develops Mystery Wild through three levels: after enough winning clusters, the symbol reveals Wild, Scatter or Magnet.
The new Light Gun removes two paying symbol types, while Magnet pulls matching symbols together. Instant Prizes lock in Free Spins, where Collector and Multiplicator work with their values.
push-gaming-retroverse.editorial: This version differs from Retro Sweets through Light Gun and a separate level-based Wild Mystery rather than only pixel art.

features.title: Three-level Wild Mystery
features.description: The symbol reveals a reward only after contributing to the required number of clusters.

features.title: Light Gun
features.description: Removes two ordinary paying symbol types from the current grid.

features.title: Collector and Multiplicator
features.description: In Free Spins, one gathers coin values, while the other multiplies neighbouring Instant Prizes and Collectors.

intro: Cube Mania Deluxe’s nine paylines work in both directions, while Cascading Reels allows new combinations after winning symbols disappear.
Unlike a simple retro game, this separates Mystery Bonus from question marks, Free Spins from Scatters, and doubling through Wild and a wall of symbols.
wazdan-cube-mania-deluxe.editorial: Deluxe should not be mechanically equated with Cube Mania: it has its own technical profile and a lower stated maximum of 570x. The cascade sequence matters rather than one dice landing.

features.title: Cascades with repeat combinations
features.description: Paid symbols disappear, making room for new ones; winning combinations can continue within the same spin.

features.title: Scatter and Mystery
features.description: Three coin Scatters unlock 15 free spins, while four award 30. Three question marks trigger Mystery Bonus.

features.title: Wild x2 and wall x2
features.description: The jester acts as Wild, while a wall combination of specific card symbols doubles the result. These events should not be confused with Mystery Bonus.

intro: Lord of Thunder combines a 3×5 grid with fifteen paylines and lightning that adds Cash and Collector symbols to the retro slot.
Collect on the middle reel takes Bonus coin values from the edges. Hold & Win retains up to five Collect symbols, while Coin Metre provides an alternative bonus entry.
3-oaks-gaming-lord-of-thunder.editorial: Up to five Collect symbols belong to the bonus’s middle reel rather than five main reels. Fixed jackpots are not guaranteed from one lightning strike.

features.title: Collect on the middle reel
features.description: The lightning coin gathers prize values from Gold Bonus Coins on neighbouring reels.

features.title: Hold & Win with up to five Collect symbols
features.description: Collectors lock and can absorb new coin values during the respin series.

features.title: Lord of thunder and Coin Metre
features.description: Lightning adds Bonus, Collect and jackpot symbols to the grid, while the counter offers a second bonus route.

intro: Three or more Coin symbols, Jackpot Markers or their combination form a separate cash win after ordinary payouts. Coins pay their values, while Jackpot Markers reveal one of four jackpots.

Rainbow triggers Rainbow Fortune Hold & Win with three restoring lives, while Epic Rainbow triggers enhanced Rainbow Epic Drop Hold & Win with a special-symbol-filled grid and Pot of Gold from the start.
hacksaw-gaming-le-sortudo.editorial: Le Sortudo makes Rainbow a switch between two Hold & Win modes rather than simply a special symbol: the ordinary mode gradually collects Coins and Markers, while Epic starts with a grid already filled with special symbols.

features.title: Coins and Jackpot Markers
features.description: Three or more Coins or Jackpot Markers, including a mixed group, form a cash payout separately from ordinary paylines. Coins show amounts, while Markers involved in a win reveal one of four jackpots.

features.title: Rainbow Fortune Hold & Win
features.description: One ordinary Rainbow triggers Hold & Win with three restoring lives. Coins and Jackpot Markers can lock on the grid, while Clover and Pot of Gold change the final collection.

features.title: Rainbow Epic Drop Hold & Win
features.description: Epic Rainbow unlocks enhanced Hold & Win with the same three restoring lives. The grid starts filled with special symbols and includes Pot of Gold, unlike ordinary Rainbow Fortune.

intro: The game uses a 6×6 cascading grid and cluster pays. Synchronised reels increase the chance of large clusters, while three consecutive cascades raise the overall Multiplier by +1 to a maximum of x3 in ordinary play.

Charlie Chance Mega Wild remains sticky during a cascade; nearby low-paying symbols are destroyed, after which Charlie becomes Mega Wild. The multiplier can grow to x10 in Free Spins, while random spins add 5–8 Scarab Wilds to the grid.
playn-go-charlie-chance-and-the-curse-of.editorial: Curse of Cleopatra turns Charlie from the series’ ordinary protagonist into an active cascade-grid element. His Mega Wild does more than substitute for symbols, clearing neighbouring low-paying positions, while synchronised reels help trigger longer cluster chains.

features.title: 6×6 cluster grid
features.description: Clusters on the 6×6 grid participate in cascades, while synchronised reels help create large groups.

features.title: Charlie Mega Wild
features.description: Charlie locks during a cascade, destroys neighbouring low-paying symbols and becomes Mega Wild.

features.title: Cascade multiplier
features.description: Three consecutive cascades raise the multiplier up to x3 in the base game.

features.title: Free Spins
features.description: The multiplier can reach x10 in the bonus, while random spins add Scarab Wilds.

intro: Samurai's Katana uses four-symbol Wild Stacks on reels 2–4 and separate Instant Prizes on the outer reels. Stacks can nudge down through Nudging Wilds.
Before Free Spins, Gamble Wheel offers the risk of losing or strengthening the bonus. Wild Stack movement increases the Free Spins multiplier meter up to x100.
push-gaming-samurais-katana.editorial: The connection between specific reels and the bonus matters: base-game Wild Stacks are restricted to the central three, while Free Spins allows them in any column.

features.title: Wild Stacks
features.description: A stack of four Wilds can nudge through a respin series.

features.title: Instant Prize
features.description: Values on the first and fifth reels pay with the corresponding Wilds in central columns.

features.title: Gamble Wheel
features.description: After Free Spins triggers, it allows the starting bonus to be exchanged for a potentially stronger variant.

intro: Demon Jack 27 has only three reels but 27 paylines: this is not a standard three-reel variant with one or five paylines.
The main enhancement is x3 Wall Multiplier, while Wild helps form combinations. The official profile separately states a maximum of 1104x the stake.
wazdan-demon-jack-27.editorial: Demon Jack 27 centres on 27-payline density and a short enhancement set. No free spins or Hold the Jackpot are stated here and should not be added by analogy with other Wazdan slots.

features.title: Twenty-seven paylines
features.description: All 27 paylines run across three reels, as confirmed by Wazdan’s separate Game Info.

features.title: Wild
features.description: Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols when forming winning combinations.

features.title: Wall multiplier x3
features.description: x3 Wall Multiplier enhances the win from the relevant screen fill rather than representing the overall maximum win.

intro: Lucky Apple x1000 is a fairy-tale Scatter Pays game on a 6×5 grid, where eight matching symbols award a win and trigger Cascading Reels.
Red apples contain x2–x1000 multipliers; Mystery reveals its value only after cascades finish. In Free Spins, multipliers increase the overall Total Multiplier.
3-oaks-gaming-lucky-apple-x1000.editorial: The x1000 name describes an individual multiplier, while the official release states a theoretical result of up to 20,000x. These are different quantities, and neither guarantees a win.

features.title: Cascades from eight matches
features.description: Paid symbols are removed from the grid, freeing positions for new potential payouts.

features.title: Apples and Mystery
features.description: Red apples add multipliers of up to x1000; Mystery reveals x10–x1000 after the cascade.

features.title: Accumulating Free Spins
features.description: Total Multiplier increases through successful spins, while Bonus Shop offers two bonus variants.

intro: Six Coins of any type trigger Raid Spins: three restoring lives, Sticky Coins, Diamonds and Clovers, with Coins and Diamonds revealing cash values after the round ends.

FS positions become Sticky Grid Multipliers in the bonuses. Magic Cauldron activates Grid Multipliers and Clovers, then collects Coins, Diamonds and previous Cauldrons; Heart can increase the maximum lives.
hacksaw-gaming-le-viking.editorial: Le Viking combines hold-and-respin with positional multipliers: Raid Spins first collects values on the grid, while free-spin modes add Sticky Grid Multipliers and Magic Cauldron to consolidate everything into one growing collection.

features.title: Raid Spins: six Coins and three lives
features.description: Six Coins together trigger Raid Spins. Coins, Diamonds and Clovers remain Sticky; a new prize landing restores three lives, while three consecutive empty respins end the mode.

features.title: Green and Gold Clover in the cash phase
features.description: Coins and Diamonds reveal prize values after Raid Spins. Green Clover multiplies neighbouring Coins and Diamonds, while Gold Clover multiplies all such symbols on the grid; these effects apply before final summation.

features.title: Berserk Free Spins and Magic Cauldron
features.description: Three FS symbols unlock Berserk Free Spins with Grid Multipliers in the original Scatter cells. Magic Cauldron activates Clover and positional multipliers, gathering Coins, Diamonds and already activated Cauldrons into a combined prize.

intro: The grid uses three Wild types: ordinary, x2 and x3 Multiplier Wilds. Scatter depicts She-Devil as a small symbol in the corner of ordinary symbols; three Scatters trigger Feature Board.
On Feature Board, Charlie moves the number of spaces set by She-Devil. Spaces can award Instant Cash Prize, Re-Spin with random Wilds, Re-Spin Multiplier, Win Spin or Free Spins.
playn-go-charlie-chance-in-hell-to-pay.editorial: Hell to Pay moves its main bonus choice off the reels: three Scatters do not lead directly to one fixed mode but send Charlie onto Feature Board. The resulting feature therefore depends on the specific space where he stops.

features.title: Three Wilds
features.description: There is an ordinary Wild, x2 Multiplier Wild and x3 Multiplier Wild.

features.title: She-Devil Scatter
features.description: Three Scatters with She-Devil in symbol corners unlock Feature Board.

features.title: Feature Board
features.description: She-Devil determines how many spaces Charlie moves.

features.title: Board rewards
features.description: Rewards include Instant Cash, Re-Spin Wild, Re-Spin Multiplier, Win Spin and Free Spins.

intro: Santa Hopper builds cascades around Santa Wild and chimneys: each jump to a Chimney increases Santa’s multiplier by one and leaves a golden present.
Jingle Drop randomly adds large Mystic Symbols to the grid, while Free Spins retains Santa, presents, chimneys and Instant Prizes from the base round.
push-gaming-santa-hopper.editorial: This festive version uses a jumping Wild, unlike Santa's Vault, whose base loop centres on collecting coins in a vault.

features.title: Santa Feature
features.description: Santa jumps between Chimneys, increases his multiplier and leaves a Golden Present.

features.title: Jingle Drop
features.description: One or two large Mystery symbols can appear on the grid after a non-winning cascade.

features.title: Cluster Link Free Spins
features.description: Three Scatters hold the linked prize symbols and move the game into a bonus grid.

intro: Dino Reels 81 uses a T-Rex as Wild: the official page promises expansion to 81 winning paylines when it contributes.

Technical Game Info simultaneously lists four reels and seven paylines, while the detailed description calls it an 81-payline game. These formulations should not be presented as one undisputed number.
wazdan-dino-reels-81.editorial: The “81” name refers to payline expansion and the game description rather than reel count. The contradiction between Game Info (7) and the long description (81) remains openly stated.

features.title: T-Rex Wild
features.description: Wild substitutes for other symbols and, according to the official description, brings the payline count to 81.

features.title: Four reels
features.description: Wazdan Game Info states 4 reels and 7 paylines; the discrepancy with the game description is noted separately.

features.title: Gamble game after a payout
features.description: In Gamble, the player chooses between hidden outcomes and can try to increase a win already received.

intro: Lucky Penny uses a cascading Irish-themed 6×5 grid: eight matching symbols pay, while the leprechaun adds Penny coins.
Clover Penny Symbols contain x2–x1000. Four Scatters trigger Free Spins with accumulating overall multipliers, while another three Scatters can extend the round by five spins.
3-oaks-gaming-lucky-penny.editorial: This is a Scatter Pays series rather than Hold & Win with pots. An x1000 coin value enhances a cascade rather than representing a fixed jackpot.

features.title: Eight symbols and cascades
features.description: Each win removes symbols from the grid and allows repeat combinations without a new spin.

features.title: Penny Coins x2–x1000
features.description: Multiple coins add their values together, applying to the win after the cascade ends.

features.title: Free Spins and extension
features.description: Four Scatters unlock the bonus, while three extra can add five spins; the round multiplier accumulates.

intro: Mystery symbols land vertically on reels 2–5 and reveal high-paying symbols, Wilds or entire Mystery Reels. Wins involving revealed symbols trigger sticky respins, continuing until a spin without a new win or a Mystery Reel appearing.
Mystery Reels reveal Coins, Diamonds, Clovers and Pots of Gold: the first provide cash prizes, Clovers multiply values, and Pot of Gold gathers everything into the combined total.
hacksaw-gaming-le-zeus.editorial: Le Zeus links Mystery Reveal to respins: an ordinary reveal can hold a win and trigger another attempt, while Mystery Reel moves the round into a cash phase with Coins, multipliers and a shared collector.

features.title: Mystery Reveal on reels 2–5
features.description: Vertical Mystery Symbols appear on the inner reels and reveal high-paying symbols, Wilds or entire Mystery Reels. A win after revealing can trigger Sticky Respins.

features.title: Mystery Reels and cash symbols
features.description: Mystery Reel moves the reveal into a cash phase with Coins, Diamonds, Clovers and Pots of Gold. Coins award prizes, Clover increases values, and Pot of Gold collects them after every activation.

features.title: Bolt & Run, Myth-Taken Identity, Gods Just Wanna Have Fun
features.description: Three FS symbols award eight Bolt & Run spins with Sticky Mystery. Four trigger Myth-Taken Identity with Mystery Meter and reward spins; five FS symbols award the third mode with Mystery on four of six reels from the start.

intro: Tiger Wild substitutes for ordinary symbols except Monkey and Dragon. Dragon appears only on reels 3–5 and triggers Dragon fireworks bonus game, where each successfully launched firework awards coins, while an explosion on the ground ends the round.

Monkey appears only on reels 1, 3 and 5; its combination pays 5x the total bet and triggers Free Spins. A fireworks wheel randomly selects one ordinary symbol as Extra Scatter before the series; retriggers and Dragon bonus are unavailable in Free Spins.
playn-go-chinese-new-year.editorial: Chinese New Year separates two festive bonuses through different Scatter symbols: Dragon leads to a risky fireworks round, while Monkey leads to Free Spins with an Extra Scatter selected beforehand. These modes do not mix within Free Spins.

features.title: Tiger Wild
features.description: Tiger substitutes for ordinary symbols but not Monkey or Dragon.

features.title: Dragon Fireworks
features.description: Dragon on reels 3–5 triggers a separate fireworks round.

features.title: Monkey Free Spins
features.description: Monkey on reels 1, 3 and 5 triggers Free Spins.

features.title: Extra Scatter
features.description: The wheel assigns an extra Scatter before Free Spins; Dragon bonus does not trigger there.

intro: Santa's Vault uses three reels and a central Collector: coins and Jackpots on the first and third reels collect only together with the central Vault Collector.
Coins also fill the upper vault, which can reveal extra prizes and trigger the bonus. New bonus values reset the attempt counter to three, while Enhancer Reels appear above the reels.
push-gaming-santas-vault.editorial: The similarity to Power Vault lies in the collection principle, but Santa's Vault has its own festive version and separately confirmed prize values.

features.title: Vault Collector
features.description: Coins on the edges pay with Collector on the second reel.

features.title: Vault
features.description: Accumulated Coins can randomly unlock the bonus before the standard combination appears.

features.title: Enhancer Reels
features.description: In the bonus, separate values above the grid add to or multiply Instant Prizes.

intro: Double Tigers pits blue and fiery tigers against each other, focusing on simple paylines without separate jackpot modes.
Wazdan’s profile states three reels and eight paylines, but the long official text mentions five reels. The reel-count discrepancy should not be hidden.
wazdan-double-tigers.editorial: Double Tigers has a catalogue-unusual stated ceiling of 40x and a simple game loop. Replacing its characteristics with those of more complex Wazdan Eastern-themed games would distort comparisons.

features.title: Eight paylines
features.description: Official Game Info lists 8 paylines as the main way to form ordinary winning combinations.

features.title: Risk Game
features.description: After a payout, Wazdan’s separately listed Unique Gamble Feature offers an opportunity to double the prize.

features.title: Volatility Levels
features.description: The manufacturer lists three adjustable volatility profiles: low, high and standard.

intro: Lucky Penny 2 retains cascading payouts for eight symbols on a 6×5 grid but adds a separate Mystery Multiplier.
Mystery’s value stays hidden until the sequence ends and ranges from x10 to x1000. Four Scatters unlock Free Spins with an accumulating overall multiplier.
3-oaks-gaming-lucky-penny-2.editorial: Unlike the first Lucky Penny, this has a Mystery multiplier. It differs from Penny Coin, which can land independently or appear through the leprechaun.

features.title: Mystery Multiplier x10–x1000
features.description: A random coin hides its value until the cascade series ends.

features.title: Ordinary Penny Coins
features.description: Coins award multipliers of up to x1000 and add together when the winning spin is calculated.

features.title: Free Spins and Super Free Spins
features.description: Four Scatters unlock Free Spins, while purchased Super mode guarantees a minimum x10 multiplier.

intro: Magic Hat determines what every Magic Piggy symbol turns into and becomes the same symbol itself. Piggies can reveal Wild or Bill Stacks, and sometimes a Multiplier Coin that boosts one or more Bill Stacks.

Three FS symbols trigger Pig Bonus with 10 free spins: Piggy Points accumulate, while Magic Hat helps fill reels with Piggies. EPIG Bonus with four FS symbols keeps Piggy Points progressive without resetting after Magic Hat.
hacksaw-gaming-magic-piggy-og.editorial: Magic Piggy OG builds each major event around a shared transformation: one Magic Hat determines every Piggy’s result on the grid at once. The bonuses differ in whether Piggy Point progress resets or keeps accumulating.

features.title: Magic Hat changes every Magic Piggy
features.description: Magic Hat selects a shared result for every Magic Piggy on the grid and becomes the same symbol itself. Outcomes include Wild, Bill Stacks and Multiplier Coin, which enhances collected cash values.

features.title: Bill Stacks and Multiplier Coins
features.description: Revealed Bill Stacks award values that add together and are calculated relative to the stake. Multiplier Coin can boost one or more Bill Stacks, so its role differs from Wild substitution.

features.title: Pig Bonus versus EPIG Bonus
features.description: Three FS symbols trigger ten Pig Bonus Spins with Piggy Point collection expanding Magic Hat’s effect. Four FS symbols award EPIG Bonus: Piggy Points remain between Magic Hat activations rather than resetting every time.
